About Drive Thru

Kahnawake's trusted source for premium vape products and exceptional drive-through service

Our Story

Founded in the heart of Kahnawake, Drive Thru was born from a simple idea: combine premium quality vape products with the convenience of drive-through service. We recognized that our community needed a reliable, trustworthy source for tobacco and vaping products that respected their time and valued their business.

Since opening our doors, we've grown to become one of the most trusted vape and smoke shops in the region. Our commitment to authentic products, competitive pricing, and exceptional customer service has earned us a loyal customer base throughout Kahnawake and the greater Montreal area.

We're more than just a retail store—we're part of the community. We sponsor local events, support community initiatives, and strive to be responsible corporate citizens in everything we do.

🏪

Why Choose Drive Thru?

✓

Drive-Through Convenience

Our unique drive-through service means you can get your products without leaving your vehicle. Perfect for busy schedules or inclement weather.

✓

Competitive Pricing

We offer some of the best prices in the region, ensuring you get great value on every purchase.

✓

Wide Selection

From the latest pod systems to classic cigarettes, we carry a comprehensive range of products to meet every customer's preferences.

Community Involvement

Proud to support Kahnawake

At Drive Thru, we believe in giving back to the community that has supported us. We're proud sponsors of local sports teams, cultural events, and community initiatives throughout Kahnawake.

We also prioritize hiring locally and providing employment opportunities for community members. Many of our team members have been with us since the beginning, and we're committed to their growth and development.

We take our responsibility as a tobacco retailer seriously. We work closely with local health authorities to promote responsible use, strictly enforce age restrictions, and provide education about the products we sell.
